itsm_closing_inputs.provenance_requirement: Must be declared by the action/convention record and cover every supplied history and source term.
itsm_closing_inputs.semantic: Mapping from repository/natural variables to the physical units used by the network and reported observables.

itsm_closing_inputs.provenance_requirement: Must state whether eta, Omega_b h^2 or another variable is primary and give the non-imported conversion.
itsm_closing_inputs.semantic: Action-derived normalization connecting baryon number, photon number and the network's abundance convention.

itsm_closing_inputs.provenance_requirement: Must be obtained from the action-derived solution and component decomposition; it must not be identified with radiation by assumption.
itsm_closing_inputs.semantic: Early-time plenum contribution kept distinct from radiation, matter and condensate components.

itsm_closing_inputs.provenance_requirement: Must be action-derived; a scalar placeholder, fitted transfer or DeltaN-matched source is insufficient unless the homogeneous reduction is explicit.
itsm_closing_inputs.semantic: Matter/plenum exchange current with its index structure, sign convention and conservation placement declared.

itsm_closing_inputs.provenance_requirement: Must be action-derived with its own sign, conservation equation and any exchange closure; it cannot be collapsed into Q_mp.
itsm_closing_inputs.semantic: Reservoir/plenum exchange current distinct from the matter/plenum current.

itsm_closing_inputs.provenance_requirement: Must follow from the declared interaction and charge convention; it must not be supplied by fitting DeltaN or by a standard-network default.
itsm_closing_inputs.semantic: Condensate-number/charge source entering the baryon or charge evolution equation.

itsm_closing_inputs.provenance_requirement: Must be derived from the action and constraint system, including its perturbation-level meaning; an observationally selected coupling is rejected.
itsm_closing_inputs.semantic: Time/background-dependent effective gravitational coupling used by the expansion and perturbation equations.

itsm_closing_inputs.provenance_requirement: Must be derived from the constrained perturbation equations; background-only matching does not close this field.
itsm_closing_inputs.semantic: Map from the ITSM background/perturbation variables to the metric and source quantities consumed by the BBN/network interface.

network_history.provenance_requirement: Must be exported by the registered upstream solution or by an explicitly documented action-level map; a dimensionless label is insufficient.
network_history.semantic: Physical evolution coordinate with an explicit unit and monotonicity/domain declaration.

network_history.provenance_requirement: Must be action-derived or connected by a declared thermodynamic map; it must not be inferred from a, rho, mu or H.
network_history.semantic: Photon temperature history supplied to the nuclear-reaction network, with the thermal regime and physical unit declared.

network_history.provenance_requirement: Must be exported or derived by a declared differentiable action-level background map; finite differences without an error and resolution declaration are insufficient.
network_history.semantic: Derivative of the photon-temperature history in the same declared time and unit convention.

network_history.provenance_requirement: Must be supplied by the upstream thermodynamic/evolution solution; standard-cosmology substitution must be identified and is not an ITSM closure.
network_history.semantic: Neutrino temperature history or a declared non-equilibrium replacement required by the selected network.

network_history.provenance_requirement: Must be action-derived from the physical background equations; a dimensionless H label or imported target expansion is insufficient.
network_history.semantic: Expansion rate in the same physical time convention as the temperature histories.

network_history.provenance_requirement: Must have a physical-unit and normalization map; an observational baryon target or an unlabelled eta proxy is not an action-derived input.
network_history.semantic: Baryon-number history or an explicitly declared eta-compatible normalization mapped into the network variables.
